title: CODA-CS: The Continuum Shadow — Continuum Re-Presentations that Descend to the Finite Calculus
description: CODA-CS is the finite-shadow sieve for continuum-looking queries. A continuum limit notation does not mint authority. Local Lean and Python check continuum non-creation, shadow-slice necessity, and fiber-constancy consequences of factorization on declared finite shadows. Authorized gluing (H3-prime-prime / GTLA-T26) remains open. Profile-factorization bridge theorems that live in the CS-Q package are not claimed as theorems of this deposit. This deposit is a new version of concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20482295 and replaces the title General Theory of the Continuum.
notes: Canonical Repository of Record deposit candidate. Deposit and publication require explicit human authorization.
